Metadata.title: Solana Developer Platform
Metadata.description: Build any financial product on Solana without worrying about the infrastructure. SDP provides the APIs for custody, payments, issuance, and policy controls behind stablecoins, cross-border payments, and tokenized assets.

Home.title: Build any financial product, without worrying about the infrastructure
Home.description: Whether you're issuing a stablecoin, orchestrating cross-border payments, or tokenizing real-world assets, SDP provides the most reliable APIs and infrastructure to make it happen.
